prompt_preamble: Audit and implement only a read-only verifier for the original x86 call boundary from entry_point 0x100edd70 to 0x100ed3c0. Never execute, translate, or link 0x100ed3c0. Repository sources, the original PE, and the canonical corpus are immutable. Implementation-stage work belongs only in isolated worker directories and may parse bytes but may not invoke recovered code. Structured artifacts must match their schemas exactly; external telemetry, not worker self-report, is authoritative. The startup ABI evidence gate is admitted only to pin validation syntax and source-path rules; neither semantic-gate version is machine-fact evidence, and no claim may cite one as its source. E-stage artifacts are closed-world contracts: use exactly the listed fact IDs, values, sources, inference flags, counts, and frozen conclusion, with no optional claims or extra prose; blockers must be an empty array. Every E-stage fact_id must begin with that worker's ID and a period; every claim must use kind=contract and locator=complete source exactly. For every E-stage claim, extractor_command must be one single-line structured Pi recipe exactly in the form read {"path":"...","offset":0,"limit":20000}. It must read the complete cited source from offset zero; the embedded object must be valid JSON, and path must be either source_path exactly or an existing hash-identical absolute copy ending at a full source_path boundary without traversal. Grep, partial reads, shell flags, prose, line-range shorthand, then-read, or same-file recipes are forbidden for frozen facts. The accepted native 0x100f1aa0 empty-source slice is BUILD_TESTING-only corroboration, not raw-x86 authority or a production component. Never copy, import, link, export, or propose promoting its C source, runtime test, or static gate. Original x86 0x100f1aa0 calls 0x100ef330, never 0x100f1c10; 0x100f1c10 is only the accepted native test delegate. Treat 0x11af4090 as an opaque 32-bit guest identity, never a host pointer. ST2-* labels are context-only; structured outputs must use only the allowed ABI-* requirement IDs. The native API, status precedence, alias rules, and runtime matrix are outside this ABI-auditor milestone. In I/G manifests, files lists only the other deliverable files and must never list or hash the manifest itself. In R findings, candidate_sha256 is the exact dependency artifact hash of that candidate's submission.json from the admitted dependency manifest.

stages.description: Independently audit caller packets, callee stack/register behavior, and small direct-callee seams.
Design independent raw-byte, stack-flow, mutation, and containment oracles.
Build isolated standard-library read-only ABI auditors and negative-control candidate packets; never execute recovered startup.
Cross-review every auditor with independent malformed and semantic reproducers.
Produce two isolated integration candidates for a fail-closed ABI audit and frozen conclusion.

workers.task: Audit the two authenticated calls from 0x100edd70 to 0x100ed3c0 from the supervisor-authenticated raw fixture, whose independent verifier binds it to the pinned original PE. The direct packet proves ESI reaches callee position 1 and EDI reaches position 3; mapping those register values back to earlier caller EBP slots remains conditional without a complete no-clobber def/use proof. Emit exactly eight claims and no optional claims. Source these seven inference=false facts to scripts/x64_startup_100ed3c0_abi_fixture.json: E01.cleanup-mechanics=CALLER_CLEANUP_GROUPED_24;CALLEE_CLEANUP_0; E01.packet-slot-order=P1_ESI;P2_EBP_PLUS_0C;P3_EDI;P4_EBP_PLUS_24; E01.prior-load-restraint=ESI_EDI_PRIOR_LOADS_NOT_FULL_DEF_USE; E01.handler-packet-rows=0x100EDF20_FF7524;0x100EDF23_57;0x100EDF24_FF750C;0x100EDF27_56;0x100EDF28_E893F4FFFF; E01.no-handler-packet-rows=0x100EDF73_FF7524;0x100EDF76_57;0x100EDF77_FF750C;0x100EDF7A_56;0x100EDF7B_E840F4FFFF; E01.handler-window-sha256=HANDLER_WINDOW_SHA256_52227B99B8D956F8926EB0F02B0F3B8C62A229DEE20653B5608DC81A96E41084; E01.no-handler-window-sha256=NO_HANDLER_WINDOW_SHA256_76A454A3F06C1C8DE33F0B3B0AB432E059DE9ABCA52B342B8CAC0E9F50198D6A. Source E01.convention-restraint=CONVENTION_NAME_NOT_FROZEN with inference=false to docs/x64_startup_100ed3c0_abi_contract.md. Use a complete-source read recipe for every claim. The conclusion must be exactly: The two authenticated caller packets place ESI at P1, [EBP+0x0c] at P2, EDI at P3, and [EBP+0x24] at P4; grouped caller cleanup is 24 bytes and the convention name remains unfrozen. Do not call the target. Write evidence.json by tool call 6, re-read once, finish.

Audit every entry-stack-derived read in the complete pinned original 0x100ed3c0 body, using the supervisor-authenticated raw fixture as authority. Define E0 as ESP on callee entry: return address E0+0 and caller positions P1 through P4 at E0+4, +8, +12, and +16. Normalize every direct ESP+disp32 candidate with entry_offset = esp_delta_before + displacement at that instruction. Emit exactly six claims, all sourced to scripts/x64_startup_100ed3c0_abi_fixture.json, and no optional claims. Use inference=false for E02.entry-layout=RETURN_E0;P1_E0_PLUS_4;P2_E0_PLUS_8;P3_E0_PLUS_12;P4_E0_PLUS_16; E02.consumed-positions=READ_P1_ONCE;READ_P3_ONCE;P2_UNREAD;P4_UNREAD; E02.local-access-rows=0x100ED4B0_898C2408090000_E0_MINUS_8_WRITE;0x100ED4BA_8984240C090000_E0_MINUS_4_WRITE;0x100ED4D4_8B9424D8080000_E0_MINUS_56_READ;0x100ED4DB_8B8424D4080000_E0_MINUS_60_READ;0x100ED500_8B9424D8080000_E0_MINUS_56_READ;0x100ED50B_C78424D408000000000000_E0_MINUS_60_WRITE; E02.position-1-read=0X100ED3ED_READS_E0_PLUS_4_CALLER_POSITION_1; and E02.position-3-read=0X100ED434_READS_E0_PLUS_12_CALLER_POSITION_3. Use inference=true for E02.scan-restraint=DIRECT_ESP_DISP32_SCAN_ONLY;LOWER_BOUND_2304_IS_CONSERVATIVE;UPPER_BOUND_4096_NOT_EXHAUSTIVE;ALTERNATE_ADDRESSING_NOT_EXCLUDED. Use a complete-source read recipe for every claim. The conclusion must be exactly: Within the bounded direct ESP+disp32 audit, P1 and P3 are each read once, P2 and P4 are unread, and alternate addressing remains unexcluded. Write evidence.json by call 6, re-read once, finish.

Audit the complete pinned original 0x100ed3c0 body and both caller continuations. Emit exactly twelve claims and no optional claims. Source these seven raw facts to scripts/x64_startup_100ed3c0_abi_fixture.json: E03.frame-boundary-rows=0x100ED3C0_81EC0C090000_ESP_0_TO_MINUS_2316;0x100ED471_56_ESP_MINUS_2316_TO_MINUS_2320;0x100ED548_5E_ESP_MINUS_2320_TO_MINUS_2316;0x100ED549_81C40C090000_ESP_MINUS_2316_TO_0;0x100ED54F_C3_RET_IMMEDIATE_0; E03.local-frame-rows=0x100ED4B0_898C2408090000_E0_MINUS_8_WRITE;0x100ED4BA_8984240C090000_E0_MINUS_4_WRITE;0x100ED4D4_8B9424D8080000_E0_MINUS_56_READ;0x100ED4DB_8B8424D4080000_E0_MINUS_60_READ;0x100ED500_8B9424D8080000_E0_MINUS_56_READ;0x100ED50B_C78424D408000000000000_E0_MINUS_60_WRITE; E03.transient-stack=0x100ED434_FFB42418090000_STACK_EFFECT_NEG_4;0x100ED471_ESP_DELTA_BEFORE_NEG_2316;RECOVERY_MECHANISM_NOT_AUTHENTICATED; E03.caller-continuation-rows=0x100EDF2D_6A01;0x100EDF2F_E89C570200;0x100EDF34_6860650D10;0x100EDF39_E8B2710200;0x100EDF3E_83C418;0x100EDF80_6A01;0x100EDF82_E849570200;0x100EDF87_6860650D10;0x100EDF8C_E85F710200;0x100EDF91_83C418; E03.entry-position-rows=0x100ED3ED_8B842410090000_E0_PLUS_4_CALLER_POSITION_1_READ;0x100ED434_FFB42418090000_E0_PLUS_12_CALLER_POSITION_3_READ; E03.indirect-seams=0x100ED49E_FF5254;0x100ED4FE_FF10; and E03.caller-packet-call-sites=CALL_SITES_0X100EDF28_AND_0X100EDF7B_TARGET_0X100ED3C0. Only E03.transient-stack uses inference=true among those seven. Source E03.return-value-contract=RETURN_VALUE_UNSPECIFIED, E03.termination-contract=TERMINATION_NOT_GUARANTEED, E03.canonical-return-count=ONE_BARE_RETURN, and E03.canonical-parameter-observation=CANONICAL_BODY_REFERENCES_PARAM_1_AND_PARAM_3_ONLY;PARAM_2_UNUSED_AFTER_DECLARATION to decomp_fn_100ed3c0.c; the first two use inference=true and the latter two false. Source E03.caller-return-use=RETURN_VALUE_IGNORED_BY_CALLERS to decomp_fn_100edd70.c with inference=true. Use a complete-source read recipe for every claim. The conclusion must be exactly: The authenticated frame has one bare ret with no callee cleanup; caller cleanup is grouped, the return value is unspecified and ignored by both callers, and termination is not guaranteed. Write evidence.json by call 8, re-read once, finish.

Compare direct startup callees 0x100f1aa0, 0x100f1bb0, 0x100df270, and 0x100f1cc0 for the smallest independently portable path, including each immediate callee admitted in context. Read all nine declared context files before concluding. Emit exactly twelve claims and no optional claims. Include the five decision facts with inference=true: E04.empty-copy-decision=GO_EMPTY_ONLY from decomp_fn_100ef330.c; E04.full-copy-decision=NO_GO_FULL_FUNCTION_ALLOCATOR_PATH from decomp_fn_100ef330.c; E04.string-scan-decision=NO_GO_UNBOUNDED_SCAN from decomp_fn_100f1bb0.c; E04.release-decision=NO_GO_OWNING_RELEASE_CALLBACK_PATH from decomp_fn_100f1cc0.c; and E04.platform-decision=NO_GO_PLATFORM_BOUND from decomp_fn_100df270.c. Include these six direct facts with inference=false: E04.f1aa0-call-boundary=CALLS_100EF330_WITH_PARAM2_INDEX_2_AND_PARAM2_INDEX_2_PLUS_IVAR1_TIMES_2 from decomp_fn_100f1aa0.c; E04.allocation-header-store=UVAR5_MINUS_4_STORES_100FCC80_RETURN_IVAR2 from decomp_fn_100ef330.c; E04.release-header-load=PUVAR1_MINUS_2_LOADS_IVAR2;IVAR2_NONZERO_GATES_10124E50_CALL;IVAR2_PASSED_TO_10124E50 from decomp_fn_100f1cc0.c; E04.platform-visible-calls=LOADSTRINGW;CREATEMUTEXW;MESSAGEBOXW;SYSTEMPARAMETERSINFOW from decomp_fn_100df270.c; E04.allocator-visible-heap-call=100FCC80_DIRECTLY_CALLS_GETPROCESSHEAP from decomp_fn_100fcc80.c; and E04.guest-identity-restraint=0X11AF4090_GUEST_IDENTITY_NOT_NATIVE_POINTER from docs/x64_startup_100ed3c0_abi_contract.md. Include E04.release-callee-audit=10124E50_REQUIRES_SEPARATE_NATIVE_RELEASE_DESIGN from decomp_fn_10124e50.c with inference=true. Full 0x100f1aa0 is NO-GO because nonempty 0x100ef330 allocates through 0x100fcc80; audit the zero-length branch separately without claiming both behaviors are decided inside 0x100ef330. The full scan, release, and platform paths remain NO-GO. Use a complete-source read recipe for every claim. The conclusion must be exactly: The smallest independently portable slice is the empty-only 0x100f1aa0 slice. The full allocator, unbounded scan, owning release, and platform-bound paths are NO-GO. 0x11af4090 is a 32-bit guest identity and is never a native pointer. Avoid invented semantics and never propose running a parent. Write schema-valid evidence.json by completed result 14, re-read the complete file once, and finish by result 17.

Implement a complete standard-library read-only 0x100ed3c0 ABI auditor satisfying all eight frozen requirements, with direct callee 0x100d6560 as its special negative control. Authenticate the caller/callee boundary plus the control's exact one-byte body and parent call site, prove only no-op behavior for the control, and explicitly reject inferred arity/name/export/native linkage. Test that push count is never mistaken for consumed parameters. Produce exactly audit_100ed3c0_abi.py, test_audit_100ed3c0_abi.py, README.md, submission.json; submission.files lists only the other three payload files and excludes submission.json; never execute x86 and remove caches.

Implement a complete standard-library read-only 0x100ed3c0 ABI auditor satisfying all eight frozen requirements, with the exact empty-only 0x100f1aa0 to 0x100ef330 path as its special bounded-slice control. Independently recompute the empty-slice fixture facts from the original PE, canonical index, and canonical sources; importing or calling the supplied provenance verifier is insufficient. Authenticate the caller/callee boundary and empty-path bytes, reject the allocating/nonempty path, and never freeze the parent ABI. Implement only read-only auditing and never reproduce the native borrowed-view/status behavior. Produce exactly audit_100ed3c0_abi.py, test_audit_100ed3c0_abi.py, README.md, submission.json; submission.files lists only the other three payload files and excludes submission.json; never execute x86 and remove caches.

Design exactly eight independent raw-PE tests and eight one-to-one mutants for the two 0x100edd70 call packets: exact bytes/hash, push count/order, operand provenance, rel32 targets, caller cleanup, truncation, duplicate-window confusion, and malformed PE mapping. Across the eight tests explicitly cover ABI-PROV-001, ABI-CALL-001, and ABI-RET-001. Do not implement or execute startup.

Design exactly eight tests and eight paired mutants for a fail-closed x86 stack/register flow auditor over the complete 400-byte 0x100ed3c0 body. Cover entry ESP normalization, pushes/pops, delayed saves, branches/loops, stack-derived memory reads, unsupported opcodes, hidden fourth-position use, and return cleanup. Across the eight tests explicitly cover ABI-STACK-001, ABI-REG-001, ABI-RET-001, and ABI-ORACLE-001.

Design exactly eight tests and eight paired mutants for selecting the exact empty-only 0x100f1aa0 to 0x100ef330 slice after 0x100f1c10 while rejecting every listed NO-GO path. Require exact index identity, raw bytes, call-site proof, no imports/calls/globals unless explicitly bounded, guest/native width discipline, and a hard stop before parent execution. Independently cover the full-body hashes, 0x100f1ab4 to 0x100ef330 call, exact 23-byte zero prefix, jne stop at 0x100ef347, excluded 0x100ef354 to 0x100fcc80 allocator call, both parent sites, guest32 identity restraint, and x86-ret/native-ABI restraint. The wrapper's helper call is admitted; the allocator call is only an authenticated exclusion. Across the eight tests explicitly cover ABI-PROV-001, ABI-ORACLE-001, ABI-CONT-001, and ABI-NOGO-001.

Design exactly eight tests and eight paired mutants for containment: standard-library-only read-only parsing, pinned PE/canonical inputs, no original-code execution, no DLL/bootstrap link, no repository writes, no invented native ABI, deterministic output, and fail-closed malformed input handling. Dedicate one existing containment test/mutant pair to rejecting any escape of the accepted empty runtime outside BUILD_TESTING or any bootstrap, probe, or export linkage. Across the eight tests explicitly cover ABI-PROV-001, ABI-ORACLE-001, ABI-CONT-001, and ABI-NOGO-001.

Implement a minimal standard-library Python auditor for the pinned original PE. It must authenticate inputs, parse PE32 mappings, verify both caller packets and the full 0x100ed3c0 body, and report only provable stack-position/cleanup facts. Never execute x86. Produce exactly audit_100ed3c0_abi.py, test_audit_100ed3c0_abi.py, README.md, submission.json; remove caches. Finish implementation/tests by call 16 and manifest by call 19.

Implement an independent fail-closed standard-library Python stack/register-flow auditor for the complete pinned 0x100ed3c0 body and its two callers. Reject unsupported or ambiguous instructions rather than guessing. Prove or reject the unused-position hypothesis and cleanup convention. Produce exactly audit_100ed3c0_abi.py, test_audit_100ed3c0_abi.py, README.md, submission.json; never execute x86 and remove caches.

Implement a small independent auditor that cross-checks raw PE caller/callee bytes, exact canonical index rows, canonical source hashes, and stack-position conclusions without using decompiler syntax as an ABI oracle. It must emit deterministic JSON and negative-test malformed/changed inputs. Produce exactly the four required files and no caches; never execute recovered code.

Implement the simplest read-only ABI auditor whose tests explicitly kill swapped pushes, omitted fourth push, changed rel32 target, callee-cleanup ret, hidden fourth-position read, incorrect saved-register provenance, malformed PE mapping, and stale canonical source. Produce exactly the four required files, standard library only, no recovered execution, no repository edits, and no caches.

Review I01, I02, and I05 against exact PE mapping, caller-window bytes, rel32 arithmetic, hashes, the no-op negative control, and malformed/truncated PE reproducers. Run independent commands, write findings.json by call 18, and remove all other workspace artifacts.

Review I02, I03, and I06 for complete stack/register flow, branch coverage, caller cleanup, hidden argument reads, empty-path containment, unsupported-opcode handling, and any invented ABI claim. Run the supplied empty-slice provenance verifier as a baseline, then test I06 independently. Fail I06 if it copies the native wrapper, claims an original call to 0x100f1c10, accepts the nonempty boundary, widens 0x11af4090, or treats x86 ret 4/ret 8 as a native ABI. candidate_sha256 must be the admitted submission.json artifact hash for each candidate. Write findings.json by call 18 and leave no other files.

Review I01, I04, and I06 adversarially. Add independent mutants for packet swap, fourth-position use, ret immediate, mapping ambiguity, duplicate index rows, stale hashes, partial reads, allocation-path leakage, and false success on unsupported instructions. Run the supplied empty-slice provenance verifier as a baseline, then test I06 independently. Fail I06 if it copies the native wrapper, claims an original call to 0x100f1c10, accepts the nonempty boundary, widens 0x11af4090, or treats x86 ret 4/ret 8 as a native ABI. candidate_sha256 must be the admitted submission.json artifact hash for each candidate. Write findings.json by call 18 and leave no other files.

Review I03, I04, and I05 for repository containment, read-only behavior, standard-library-only operation, deterministic artifacts, no-op semantic restraint, test truth, cleanup, complexity, and supervision cost. Reject any execution, native ABI freeze, or unbounded decoder claim. candidate_sha256 must be the admitted submission.json artifact hash for each candidate. Write findings.json by call 18 and leave no other files.

Integrate only hash-validated accepted components into the simplest complete read-only ABI audit. Produce exactly audit_100ed3c0_abi.py, test_audit_100ed3c0_abi.py, abi_contract.md, integration_manifest.json. Run independent tests and mutants, remove caches, never edit the repository or execute x86. A supported four-position adapter may be documented only if every accepted oracle agrees; otherwise freeze an explicit NO-GO conclusion. Integrate only raw auditing and documentation. If selecting the empty-path control, require admitted E04 and O03 artifacts plus the exact I06 artifact passed by both R02 and R03, and record all five exact artifact hashes in selected_components; otherwise leave the control explicitly unresolved/NO-GO. Finish files/tests by call 20 and manifest by call 23.

Independently integrate the strongest admitted components into a fail-closed read-only ABI audit, emphasizing malformed-input and unsupported-instruction rejection. Produce exactly audit_100ed3c0_abi.py, test_audit_100ed3c0_abi.py, abi_contract.md, integration_manifest.json; do not copy G01. Never execute x86 or edit repository files. Integrate only raw auditing and documentation. If selecting the empty-path control, require admitted E04 and O03 artifacts plus the exact I06 artifact passed by both R02 and R03, and record all five exact artifact hashes in selected_components; otherwise leave the control explicitly unresolved/NO-GO. Resolve disagreements as explicit GO/NO-GO evidence, run tests, remove caches, and finish the manifest by call 23.
